            变量思考 API 设置
            \n        
            \n          
            \n            
            \n              \n              \n            
            \n            
            \n              \n              \n            
            \n            
            \n              \n                
            \n                   \n                  API 详细配置 (点击展开/折叠)\n                
            \n                          \n              
            \n                
            \n                  此API专门负责解析AI回复的剧情，并生成用于更新游戏状态的变量操作指令。\n                
            \n                \n                \n                \n                \n                \n                \n                \n              
            \n            
            \n          
            \n          
            \n            
            \n               \n              预设管理\n            
            \n            
            \n            
            \n              \n              \n              \n              \n                 \n                恢复至空白\n              \n            
            \n          
            \n          
            \n            
            \n               \n              参考世界书\n            
            \n            
            \n              蓝灯条目将始终发送，绿灯条目将根据关键词在最近的剧情或用户想法中触发后发送。\n            
            \n            
            \n            
            \n              \n              \n            
            \n          
            \n          
            \n            
            \n               \n              可用占位符说明\n            
            \n            \n              
          • \n                 核心占位符: \n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${story_text} \n                : 本次AI生成的最新剧情原文。\n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${state_snapshot} \n                : 包含所有角色/物品等信息的完整世界状态快照。\n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${user_input} \n                : 玩家在本回合的输入内容。\n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${thinking_content} \n                : 主模型返回的\n                 <thinking> \n                标签内的思考过程。\n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 补充上下文占位符: \n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${character_biographies} \n                : 所有相关NPC的快照数据与生平传记的集合。\n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${worldGeography} \n                : 整个世界的地理信息与地图结构。\n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${sceneMapData} \n                : 当前场景的小地图布局数据。\n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${system_notifications} \n                : 来自面板操作的系统通知 (如: 建筑升级)。\n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${world_factors} \n                : 开局时选择的所有世界因子。\n              
            • \n              
          • \n                 ${playerName} \n                : 玩家的姓名。\n              
            • \n            \n

                  \n    \n    `;\n        const parser = new DOMParser();\n        const doc = parser.parseFromString(wrappedTemplate, 'text/html');\n\n        // 查找所有带有 data-show-if 属性的元素\n        const conditionalElements = doc.querySelectorAll('[data-show-if]');\n        conditionalElements.forEach(el => {\n          const rawAttr = el.getAttribute('data-show-if');\n          const keyMatch = rawAttr.match(/\\{\\{([a-zA-Z0-9_]+)\\}\\}/);\n          if (keyMatch) {\n            const key = keyMatch[1];\n            const val = dataMap[key];\n            if (!val || val.trim() === '') {\n              el.style.display = 'none';\n            }\n          }\n        });\n\n        // 获取处理后的 HTML\n        let rendered = doc.body.innerHTML;\n\n        // 3. 替换模具占位符 (Replace)\n        AIRP_PLACEHOLDER_REGEX.lastIndex = 0;\n        rendered = rendered.replace(AIRP_PLACEHOLDER_REGEX, (match, key) => {\n          return dataMap.hasOwnProperty(key) ? dataMap[key] : '';\n        });\n\n        return rendered;\n      }\n\n      const DEFAULT_DAILY_PAPER_PROMPT = `你现在是修仙界的一名资深主编，任务是根据提供的素材，排版并撰写一份精美的日报。\n\n【当前时空信息】\n- 当前玩家：旅人\n- 当前地区（坐标之间相聚1:10km）：\\${currentLocation}\n- 当前日期：\\${currentDate}\n\n【历史参考】\n- 上一份日报内容：\\${previousDailyPaper}\n\n【参考新闻】\n- 本次重点参考内容：\\${newsReference}\n\n【剧情原文】\n---\n\\${storyText}\n---\n\n【输出格式与技术栈】\n1.  输出格式: 你的回答必须且只能包含一个包裹在 \\`\\`\\`html 和 \\`\\`\\` 之间的HTML代码块。不要有任何代码块之外的解释。\n2.  内容: HTML内容必须是独立、完整的，可以直接在 \n      \n

log('set srcdoc len', srcdoc.length, 'has bridge', srcdoc.includes('TavernHelper'));
f.srcdoc = srcdoc;
f.addEventListener('load', () => log('iframe load'));

document.getElementById('probe').onclick = () => {
  try {
    const d = f.contentDocument;
    const w = f.contentWindow;
    const btn = d && d.getElementById('start-new-life-btn');
    let ls = 'n/a';
    try { w.localStorage.setItem('__t','1'); w.localStorage.removeItem('__t'); ls = 'ok'; } catch (e) { ls = String(e); }
    let idb = 'n/a';
    try { idb = w.indexedDB ? 'ok' : 'no'; } catch (e) { idb = String(e); }
    log('probe', {
      sameDoc: !!d,
      title: d?.title,
      hasBtn: !!btn,
      btnText: btn?.textContent,
      Dexie: typeof w.Dexie,
      TavernHelper: typeof w.TavernHelper,
      parentTH: typeof w.parent?.TavernHelper,
      localStorage: ls,
      indexedDB: idb,
      sandbox: f.getAttribute('sandbox'),
    });
  } catch (e) {
    log('probe fail', String(e));
  }
};

document.getElementById('click').onclick = () => {
  try {
    const btn = f.contentDocument.getElementById('start-new-life-btn');
    if (!btn) return log('no button');
    btn.click();
    log('clicked; splash hidden?', f.contentDocument.querySelector('#splash-screen')?.className);
  } catch (e) {
    log('click fail', String(e));
  }
};

// auto probe after delay
setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('probe').click(), 3000);
setTimeout(() => document.getElementById('click').click(), 4500);
